events.title: Demo Updates｜2026 年 9 月 7 日
events.summary: Thanks to 红茶, 天才哈基米, none, and everyone else in the community who reported bugs!This update includes: · Fixed several interaction-related bugs. · Added starting modifiers to all Meow Generals. · Reduced the difficulty of the first two stages in Chapter 2. · Added a new Cat God Blessing, “Old Tiles Never Die,” which lets you keep the Meow Generals who fought alongside you in the previous chapter!
